entries.title: Philippians 4:1
segments: ¶Therefore, my beloved and longed-for brethren, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, beloved.

entries.title: Philippians 4:2
segments: I implore Euodia and I implore Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.

entries.title: Philippians 4:3
segments: And I urge you also, true companion, help these women who labored with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names [are] in the Book of Life.

entries.title: Philippians 4:4
segments: Rejoice in the Lord always. Again I will say, rejoice!

entries.title: Philippians 4:5
segments: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord [is] at hand.

entries.title: Philippians 4:6
segments: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication, with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God;

entries.title: Philippians 4:7
segments: and the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:8
segments: Finally, brethren, whatever things are true, whatever things [are] noble, whatever things [are] just, whatever things [are] pure, whatever things [are] lovely, whatever things [are] of good report, if [there is] any virtue and if [there is] anything praiseworthy--meditate on these things.

entries.title: Philippians 4:9
segments: The things which you learned and received and heard and saw in me, these do, and the God of peace will be with you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:10
segments: ¶But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly that now at last your care for me has flourished again; though you surely did care, but you lacked opportunity.

entries.title: Philippians 4:11
segments: Not that I speak in regard to need, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content:

entries.title: Philippians 4:12
segments: I know how to be abased, and I know how to abound. Everywhere and in all things I have learned both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

entries.title: Philippians 4:13
segments: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

entries.title: Philippians 4:14
segments: Nevertheless you have done well that you shared in my distress.

entries.title: Philippians 4:15
segments: Now you Philippians know also that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church shared with me concerning giving and receiving but you only.

entries.title: Philippians 4:16
segments: For even in Thessalonica you sent [aid] once and again for my necessities.

entries.title: Philippians 4:17
segments: Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit that abounds to your account.

entries.title: Philippians 4:18
segments: Indeed I have all and abound. I am full, having received from Epaphroditus the things [sent] from you, a sweet-smelling aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, well pleasing to God.

entries.title: Philippians 4:19
segments: And my God shall supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Philippians 4:20
segments: ¶Now to our God and Father [be] glory forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Philippians 4:21
segments: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren who are with me greet you.

entries.title: Philippians 4:22
segments: All the saints greet you, but especially those who are of Caesar's household.

entries.title: Philippians 4:23
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
